selection_rule: A case is eligible only if ALL 4 worlds pass every frozen gate AND the independent audit passed. Choose the eligible case with the smaller offset (+0.10 before +0.20). No eligible case => no adoption, no integration, no workaround.

gates.passive_soft_limit: reported per joint (peak/P95/P99/fraction/duration) under football-physics-semantics-v2; diagnostic, not a gate

endpoints.frame: start heading frame: root XY and yaw at state index 999 (task 5.000 s, last tick before movement)
endpoints.onset: first state index >= 1000 whose start-frame dx <= -0.01 m; onset_s = its task time minus 5.0
endpoints.stop: state index 4*(250+move_steps)-1 (last tick of the last commanded policy step)
endpoints.public_odometry: frozen public adapter v2 + v117 SoleContactLegOdometry replay of the recorded packets; displacement between the reads at policy steps 250 and the stop step vs truth between the same physics instants

mechanical_original.passive_scope: football-physics-semantics-v2 diagnostic (not a gate); passive_fit_status not calibrated to physical hardware

public_sole_odometry.scope: offline replay of recorded packets; never a controller input
